title: Daily Devotional #19
paragraphs: As I reflect on Matthew chapter 19, I am reminded of the importance of surrendering my life to You and trusting in Your plans.

In the beginning of the chapter, Jesus speaks about divorce and the sanctity of marriage. He reminds us that marriage is not to be taken lightly and that divorce should only be considered in extreme cases of infidelity. This teaches me the importance of valuing and cherishing the relationships You have blessed me with, and to work through any struggles that may arise.

Next, Jesus interacts with the rich young man who asks how he can attain eternal life. Despite the man's good intentions, Jesus shows him that he is still holding onto his wealth and that he needs to surrender everything to follow Him. This challenges me to examine my own heart and consider what things in my life I may be holding onto instead of fully trusting in You.

Later in the chapter, Jesus speaks about the difficulty of entering the kingdom of heaven, comparing it to a camel passing through the eye of a needle. This reminds me that salvation is not something I can earn or achieve on my own, but rather a gift from You that I must humbly accept.

Finally, Jesus assures His disciples that those who have given up everything to follow Him will be rewarded in the end. This gives me hope and encourages me to continue to surrender my life to You, even when it may be difficult or uncomfortable.

Lord, I pray that You would help me to trust in Your plans for my life and to surrender everything to You. May I value my relationships, seek Your will above my own desires, and trust in Your grace and mercy for my salvation. Amen.
